claim: Whether a named source-described physical witness, in its stated access/use phase, can supply the existing lane clauses and the ancient usable configuration required by the proposed entry comparison.

rules.source_identity: An exact recorded feature or a labelled child witness is required. Same site, monastery, wadi or feature type alone never establishes feature identity.
rules.phase: A configuration may predate the Hasmonean–135 CE window and still qualify through dated use. Construction, use, fill and alteration remain separate; an unproved configuration date is UNKNOWN.
rules.aggregation: Child witnesses are alternate interpretations of one parent, never extra independent sites. Each child keeps only its supported clauses. Sibling descriptions cannot supply one combined configuration.
rules.decision: FAIL in any required clause rejects that child/specification only. All MATCH permits a reported subset. Any UNKNOWN prevents an established full physical/phase comparison. No identification without equally inspected alternatives and a registered unseen observation.
rules.protected: No reserved manuscript, archive arrival or Dalman plate25 fine detail opened; no closed assessment reopened. Full entry29 measurement remains under its existing closed-result rule.
